messages:
Maya Singh: Quick alert  since ~03:12 UTC we9re seeing TLS handshake failures for onboarding webhooks to certain customer endpoints on Private (VPC) deploys. Some activations are stuck and a handful of trial tenants are approaching expiry. I9ve identified 7 affected tenants. Need an urgent customer status, replay plan, and renewal-risk triage. @Ethan can you post a short tech blurb?

Ethan Cole: Root cause update: a cert rotation job pushed a new internal CA bundle that omitted some customer root certs. vpc-egress agents rejected connections to endpoints requiring the older intermediate chain. I9ve reverted the rotation and redeployed agents with the fallback trust bundle. Connectivity should resume but backlog exists.

Zara Khan: Tone for customers should be: clear, apologetic, and actionable. Suggest: "We9ve applied a fix and can manually replay activations on request. We9re prioritizing trials near expiry." Add contact + office hours.

Maya Singh: Agreed. Draft message: 

Maya Singh: Hi <Customer>  we detected delayed onboarding activations for Private deployments due to a certificate rotation issue impacting webhook deliveries. We reverted the change and applied a fix; activations should resume. If your trial is expiring soon or you9d like a manual replay, reply here or email cs@redwood.com and we9ll prioritize you. We9ll share a technical RCA and next steps shortly.  Maya, Redwood CS

Luis Fernandez: Renewal note: mark tenants with activation >48h or trial expiry within 72h as "renewal-watch". I9ll prepare bespoke outreach templates for any high-value accounts.

Ethan Cole: ETA for backlog drain: approx 1560min per tenant depending on webhook depth. No data corruption; deliveries are retriable and idempotent. I9ve kicked manual replays for three high-touch tenants.

infra-bot: [action] rollback/cert-rotation applied by Ethan Cole  job=cr-9213 status=success nodes=24

Zara Khan: I9ll schedule 30min office hours at 10:00 UTC and create a KB with manual replay steps and verification checks. Can someone paste the replay snippet?

Ethan Cole: Manual replay (internal):
```
# manual replay for CS
POST https://internal.replay/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/replay -H "Authorization: Bearer $CS_TOKEN"
watch: kubectl -n vpc-tenant-{tenant_id} logs -f replay-worker-{pod_id}
verify delivery: SELECT status, ts FROM webhook.delivery_events WHERE tenant_id={tenant_id} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20;
```

Maya Singh: Please include a short checklist CS can run before replaying: 1) confirm webhook URL reachable from our synthetic runner (link in KB), 2) confirm webhook auth headers present, 3) ask customer to hold duplicate processing for 10min.

Luis Fernandez: CRM action: I9ll flag the 7 tenants and add notes: "TLS webhook failures - replay available - renewal-watch if activation >48h or trial expiry <72h". Will also attach the office-hours calendar invite.

Zara Khan: Feedback capture: one-question pulse after resolution: "Did the replay and comms resolve your onboarding issue? Yes/No + optional comment". I9ll wire the survey into the follow-up.

Ethan Cole: Monitoring: lowered retry backoff to speed replay throughput and added an alert to watch for 5xx TLS errors post-fix. I9ll post telemetry graphs in the RCA doc EOD.

Maya Singh: Actions recap: Ethan9s tech RCA + telemetry (ETA EOD), Zara KB + office hours + survey (in progress), Luis CRM flags + renewal templates (in progress), Maya exec summary + renewal queue handoff. Post any other items here.

infra-bot: [notice] replay-job queued: tenants=7 job=replay-3923-ct status=queued

Maya Singh: Sending customer batches in 10m. If anyone needs to escalate legal/credits speak now; otherwise we9ll offer credits per SLA where applicable.

Ethan Cole: Replays starting now  first tenant showing delivered callbacks. I9ll update progress every 10min.

Zara Khan: Thanks team. I9ll post KB link and office-hours invite in 5.

Luis Fernandez: Noted. Will prepare renewal outreach for any tenant still pending at 36h."
